dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Excalibur arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, he has been observed to be highly dog reactive. Noted to vocalize loudly and lunge towards the other dogs with raised hackles. During one instance after reacting to another dog, Excalibur muzzle punches the handler's leg. Due to Excalibur's reactivity, we recommend an adult only, single pet home that makes no trips to the dog park.
dog.name: Excalibur
